authorInfo.bio: J. Beavington Atkinson (1822–1886) is the credited author of this historical edition. The source reference provides their catalogue and biographical references.

description: "Overbeck" by J. Beavington Atkinson is a biography written in the late 19th century. This work offers a comprehensive overview of the life of Johann Friedrich Overbeck, a painter who dedicated himself to reviving Christian art in a period characterized by conflicting artistic movements.
